description:
Move ReqLlmNext from imperative provider branching to a compile-time extension manifest built around default execution families, narrow override seams, and explicit fallback behavior.

Goals:
- add Spark as an authoring DSL over extension data
- preserve a default happy path for OpenAI-compatible families
- make provider/model edge cases opt-in and compile-time verified
- migrate current OpenAI and Anthropic support to the new pattern
- keep tests, fixtures, and Spec Led truth reconciled throughout

    B --> C["3 Build default family registry"]

title: Compile-time extension DSL migration
